1.ja: פלמא ראא בלעם. אן אלאצלח ענד אללה תבריך אל אסראיל
1.en: And when Balaam saw that it was more fitting before God to bless Israel
1.he: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת-יִשְׂרָאֵל

1.ja: לם ימץ' כאלמרתין אלאוולתין פי טלב אלפאלאת
1.en: he did not proceed as in the first two times in seeking omens
but turned with his intent toward their wilderness

2.ja: פלמא מד בצרה וראהם. נאזלין עלי' נצ'אם אסבטאהם
2.en: And when he extended his gaze and saw them encamped according to the order of their tribes
2.he: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת-עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת-יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו

2.en: the prophecy of God rested upon him

3.en: And he uttered his parable and said

3.ja: וקל יא אייהא אלרגל אלחדיד אלבצר
3.en: And speak, O man of sharp sight!'

4.en: 'And speak, O hearer of the words of the All-Powerful
and beholder of the visions of the All-Sufficient

5.ja: מא אגוד אכ'ביתך יא אל יעקוב
5.en: 'How goodly are your tents, O house of Jacob
and your dwellings, O house of Israel!'

6.en: 'For they are like valleys stretched out
and like gardens along a river
and like encampments pitched by God

7.en: and his planting is in abundant water
and his king shall rise above Agag
and his kingdom shall be exalted.'

8.ja: אלטאיק אלמכ'רגהם מן מצר. כארק אלרים מאנע ענהם
8.en: 'The All-Powerful who brought them out of Egypt is like the wakefulness of the wild ox, a protection over them
8.he: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ

8.en: and He shall consume his enemies among the nations
and their bones He shall gnaw, and His arrows shall strike them down.'

9.ja: ואד'י גת'א ורבץ. פהו כאסד ולבו מן ד'א יתירה
9.en: 'When he crouches and lies down, he is like a lion and a lioness — who shall rouse him?
9.he: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ

9.en: He who blesses you is blessed
and he who curses you is accursed.'

10.ja: פאשתד ג'צ'ב בלק עלי' בלעם וספק כפיה חרדא
10.en: And Balak's anger was greatly kindled against Balaam, and he clapped his two hands in fury

10.ja: וקאל לה. אנמא דעותך לתסב אעדאי
10.en: and said to him: 'I summoned you only to curse my enemies
10.he: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל-בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ

10.ja: פאד'א בך תבארך פיהם. הד'ה אלמרה אלת'אלת'ה
10.en: and behold, you have blessed them altogether; this is the third time!'
10.he: וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים

11.en: I had resolved to honor you greatly
but God has withheld you from honor.'

12.ja: אלם אקול לרסלך. אלד'י בעת'ת בהם אלי'י קאילא
12.en: 'Did I not already say to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying:'
12.he: הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל-מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר-שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי--דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר

13.ja: לו אעטאני בלק. מל ביתה פצ'ה וד'הב
13.en: 'Were Balak to give me his house full of silver and gold
13.he: אִם-יִתֶּן-לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב

13.ja: לא אסתטיע. אן אתגאוז אמר אללה
13.en: I could not transgress the command of God

13.ja: פאעמל גיידה או רדייה מן ראיי
13.en: to do good or evil of my own mind

13.ja: אנמא אלד'י יקולה אללה אקולה פקט
13.en: only what God says shall I say, and nothing else.'

14.en: 'And now, here I am departing to my people.
Come, so that I may inform you

14.ja: מא יצנע הולאי אלקום. בקומך פי אכ'ר אלאייאם
14.en: of what this people shall do to your people at the end of days.'
14.he: אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים

15.en: And he uttered his parable and said

15.ja: וקל יא אייהא אלרגל אלחדיד אלבצר
15.en: And speak, O man of sharp sight!'

16.en: 'And speak, O hearer of the words of the All-Powerful
and knower of the knowledge of the Most High
and beholder of the visions of the All-Sufficient

17.en: 'A matter I see, though it is not now
and I perceive it, though it is not near

17.ja: אן יטלע כוכב מן אל יעקוב. ויקום קצ'יב מן אל אסראיל
17.en: that a star shall rise from the house of Jacob, and a scepter-bearer shall arise from the house of Israel
17.he: דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל

17.en: and shall weaken the sides of Moab
and shall shake the rest of the sons of Shet.'

18.en: and likewise Seir and the rest of his enemies
and Israel shall grow in strength ever more.'

19.en: 'And he who rules from the house of Jacob
shall destroy the remnant from the towns.'

20.ja: ת'ם ראא אלעמלקיין. פצ'רב מת'לה וקאל
20.en: Then he saw the Amalekites, and uttered his parable and said
'The first to make war among the nations was Amalek
and its end is unto destruction.'

21.ja: ת'ם ראא אלקיניין. פצ'רב מת'לה וקאל
21.en: Then he saw the Kenites, and uttered his parable and said
'Your seat shall be firm and strong
and you shall set your nest in the rock.'

22.en: 'Yet there shall come a time for the exile of the Kenites
how many of them shall the people of Mosul (Asshur) take captive!'

23.en: And he uttered his parable and said

23.ja: אלויל למן יחיא. אד'א ציירה אלטאיק
23.en: 'Woe to him who shall be alive when the All-Powerful has brought this upon him!'

24.en: 'And the Dramians from the harbor of Cyprus
shall afflict the people of Mosul and the Hebrews
and they too shall come to destruction.'

25.ja: ת'ם קאם בלעם ומצ'א ורגע אלי' מוצ'עה
25.en: Then Balaam arose and departed and returned to his place
and Balak too went on his way.
